provenance.method: Compose separate two-point primitives using independent rational/bit/circle/arrow oracles, carrying the explicitly seeded native screen and last-line state. Python ranges specify the exclusive monotonic sweep; no SyncTERM output or Atari instruction execution.
provenance.native_foreground: Physical 9 masked to active depth; logical pen 10 retained across a mode change
provenance.native_hash: FNV-1a-64 over all 32000 big-endian native bytes, separately for zero/all-one initial planes
